sources.snippet: Overview Gemma-4-26B-A4B-StyleTune is a surgical style fine-tune of Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B model, created by Gryphe. The model modifies only a single tensor—the lm_head output projection layer responsible for token emission—while leaving all 30 transformer layers, attention heads, and MLPs completely frozen.
